headline.en: 丙 Day Master · 午 month command: read the whole-chart thread before individual symbols
headline.zhHans: 丙日主 · 午月令：先读整盘主线，再读单项符号

paragraphs.en: The most useful starting point is not a Ten-God catalogue, but how Hurting Officer pattern path, expression and output, and Day-Master carrying organize the chart together. They set the reading order for pattern, relationships, life domains and timing.
paragraphs.zhHans: 这张盘最值得先看的不是十神清单，而是伤官格路径、表达与输出、日主承载怎样同时组织整盘。它们会决定后面的格局、关系、人生主题与时间层应该用什么顺序阅读。

paragraphs.en: The raw Five-Element composition is led by fire at about 36.8%, but that is only background composition. The main thread still depends on month command, Day-Master carrying, functional groups and pillar interfaces working together.
paragraphs.zhHans: 原始五行里火约占 36.8%，但这只是组成背景。真正的主线仍要回到月令、日主承载、十神功能组与干支接口之间的组合。

title.en: Hurting Officer pattern path is the second organizing path
title.zhHans: 伤官格路径是第二条组织路径

thesis.en: 伤官 enters the month-command pattern discussion with 2 visible formation paths.
thesis.zhHans: 伤官从月令路径进入格局讨论，目前可见 2 条成格支持。

development.en: The useful question is not whether the chart can be given a pattern label, but whether formation support, Day-Master carrying, Ten-God composition and relationship modifiers can hold together.
development.zhHans: 因此这里真正要读的不是“有没有一个格局名称”，而是这些支持条件能否和日主承载、十神组合及关系修正同时成立。

condition.en: The path can be explained in depth without being promoted automatically to one final primary pattern.
condition.zhHans: 当前格局路径可以深入解释，但不会因为某一条件突出就自动升级成唯一主格。

title.en: expression and output comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 表达与输出在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 35.7% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Eating God and Hurting Officer, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 35.7%，主要由食神、伤官构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: expression and output deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「表达与输出」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how expression and output changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「表达与输出」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

title.en: Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading
title.zhHans: 日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题

thesis.en: The current carrying structure shows support and carrying are more visible: roots 3, visible support 5, drain/consumption 1, and pressure 1.
thesis.zhHans: 当前承载结构呈「承载与支持侧更明显」：根气 3、可见生扶 5、泄耗 1、克 1。

development.en: This changes how much support, output cost and external demand the other themes can actually carry, which is more informative than applying a one-word strong/weak sticker.
development.zhHans: 这组结构决定其他主题落到现实运行时有多少支撑、多少输出成本、又要面对多少外部要求，因此它比单独贴“身强／身弱”更有解释力。

condition.en: This describes carrying conditions. It does not create a weighted strength score or turn a temporary pressure state into a fixed identity.
condition.zhHans: 这里读的是承载条件，不制造加权旺衰分数，也不把一个阶段性的压力状态当成固定身份。

title.en: The selected timing window is re-emphasizing natal themes
title.zhHans: 所选时间窗口正在重新放大原局已有主题

thesis.en: This timing window contains 0 cross-layer groups and 3 timing interactions, making timing relevant to the main reading thread.
thesis.zhHans: 这个时间窗口可见 0 组跨层结构与 3 项时间互动，因此时间层值得进入主线阅读。

development.en: Timing does not create a new natal chart; it changes which already-present natal themes move closer to the foreground through Da Yun and Liu Nian.
development.zhHans: 时间层不会产生一张新的命盘；它只是让原局某些已经存在的主题在大运与流年里更靠前。

condition.en: Foregrounding means the theme deserves attention in this period, not that a specific event must happen.
condition.zhHans: 前景化表示这个阶段更值得观察，不等于某个事件必然发生。

title.en: peer and self-position comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 同类与自我位置在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 21.4% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Peer and Rob Wealth, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 21.4%，主要由比肩、劫财构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: peer and self-position deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「同类与自我位置」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how peer and self-position changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「同类与自我位置」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

lead.en: Work is read here as the way output, responsibility, resources and learning are organized into a usable role.
lead.zhHans: 事业主题看的是表达产出、规则责任、资源交换与学习支持怎样组织成可持续的工作方式。

development.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 35.7%, carried mainly by Indirect Wealth, Eating God, and Hurting Officer. It also connects to Hurting Officer pattern path. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 35.7%），主要连接到偏财、食神、伤官。同时可连接到伤官格路径。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Career structure can change with role, organization and timing. This describes work dynamics rather than fixing one profession into a guaranteed success-or-failure outcome.
condition.zhHans: 事业结构会随角色、组织环境与阶段而改变；这里说明的是工作运行方式，不把它直接写成某个职业的固定成败结论。

lead.en: Wealth is read as the chart’s resource flow: what can be produced, managed, exchanged and protected.
lead.zhHans: 财富主题看的是资源怎样被产出、管理、交换与保留，而不是把一个财星直接等同于财富结果。

development.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 35.7%, carried mainly by Indirect Wealth, Eating God, and Peer. It also connects to Hurting Officer pattern path. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 35.7%），主要连接到偏财、食神、比肩。同时可连接到伤官格路径。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Resource structure describes how money, opportunity and exchange enter the chart; it is not an income promise. Real outcomes still depend on choices, markets, responsibilities and timing.
condition.zhHans: 资源结构说明钱、机会与交换怎样进入命盘，不等同实际收入承诺；现实结果仍取决于选择、市场、责任与时间条件。

lead.en: Relationships are read through recurring interfaces between self-position, rules, resources and support, not through a single spouse label.
lead.zhHans: 关系主题看自我位置、规则、资源与支持怎样在不同关系接口里反复出现，而不是把某一柱直接等同某个人。

development.en: For relationships, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 21.4%, carried mainly by Indirect Wealth, Peer, and Direct Officer. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone. It directly reconnects to 1 whole-chart priority theme, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「关系」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 21.4%），主要连接到偏财、比肩、正官。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径。它与整盘 1 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Relationship structure is best used to observe interaction style, boundaries and recurring interfaces rather than to predict marriage, separation or one fixed partner outcome.
condition.zhHans: 关系结构更适合观察互动方式、边界与反复接口，不把它直接翻译成结婚、分手或某一种伴侣结果。

lead.en: Family and background are read as the chart’s support, belonging and environmental interfaces rather than fixed family-member assignments.
lead.zhHans: 家庭与背景主题看支持、归属与环境接口怎样组合，不把某一柱固定对应成某位家人。

development.en: For family and background, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 21.4%, carried mainly by Indirect Wealth, Peer, and Direct Officer. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone. It directly reconnects to 1 whole-chart priority theme, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「家庭与背景」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 21.4%），主要连接到偏财、比肩、正官。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径。它与整盘 1 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Family roles and real people change across life stages, so this reading stays with support and environmental structure instead of assigning one pillar to one family member.
condition.zhHans: 家庭角色与现实成员会随人生阶段变化，因此这里只读支持与环境结构，不固定指定哪一柱就是哪一位家人。

lead.en: Capability is read from what can be absorbed, practiced, expressed and repeatedly carried.
lead.zhHans: 能力主题看一项东西能否被吸收、练习、表达并反复承载。

development.en: For capability and expression, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 35.7%, carried mainly by Eating God, Peer, and Hurting Officer. It also connects to Hurting Officer pattern path and Jian Lu / Yue Jie path. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「能力与表达」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 35.7%），主要连接到食神、比肩、伤官。同时可连接到伤官格路径、建禄／月劫路径。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Reliability still depends on whether roots 3, support 5 and output cost 1 can work together over time.
condition.zhHans: 能力是否稳定，要继续看根气 3、生扶 5 与输出成本 1 能不能长期配合。

lead.en: Pressure is read from standards and control together with the support available to carry them.
lead.zhHans: 压力主题把规则与受克放在可用支持和承载条件里一起读。

development.en: For pressure and responsibility, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 14.3%, carried mainly by Eating God, Peer, and Hurting Officer. It also connects to Hurting Officer pattern path. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「压力与责任」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 14.3%），主要连接到食神、比肩、伤官。同时可连接到伤官格路径。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: The carrying side currently shows support and carrying are more visible, so pressure should be read against visible support 5 and pressure 1, not Officer count alone.
condition.zhHans: 承载侧目前呈「承载与支持侧更明显」，所以压力要同时看可用支持 5 与受克 1，不能只看官杀数量。

lead.en: Life operation asks whether support, output, resources, responsibility and relationships can circulate as one system.
lead.zhHans: 生活运行看支持、输出、资源、责任与关系能不能形成一套可持续循环。

development.en: For life operation, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 35.7%, carried mainly by Indirect Wealth, Eating God, and Peer. It also connects to Hurting Officer pattern path and Jian Lu / Yue Jie path. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「生活运行」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 35.7%），主要连接到偏财、食神、比肩。同时可连接到伤官格路径、建禄／月劫路径。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

headline.en: 2026-10-09: 甲戌 Da Yun × 丙午 Liu Nian

paragraphs.en: This window does not create a new chart; it carries the natal thread into time. The current Da Yun brings in learning, support and absorption, expression and output, resources and exchange, and peer and self-position, while Liu Nian adds peer and self-position and expression and output, reconnecting to expression and output, Day-Master carrying, and timing activation.
paragraphs.zhHans: 这个窗口不是另起一张命盘，而是把原局主线带进时间层。当前大运带入学习、支持与吸收、表达与输出、资源与交换、同类与自我位置，流年再加入同类与自我位置、表达与输出；它们重新连接到表达与输出、日主承载、时间激活。

paragraphs.en: capability and expression, career and work, and family and background move closer to the foreground in this window. When Da Yun and Liu Nian point to the same domain, the convergence increases structural relevance rather than proving an event.
paragraphs.zhHans: 能力与表达、事业与工作、家庭与背景在这个窗口更靠前。 如果大运与流年同时指向同一主题，只表示结构相关性增加，不把这种汇合写成事件确定性。

prompt.en: For priority 1, “Hurting Officer pattern path is the second organizing path”: When this pattern path works best in real life, which supporting conditions tend to appear together rather than separately?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「伤官格路径是第二条组织路径」：这条格局路径在现实里运行得比较顺时，哪些支持条件通常会一起出现，而不是各自单独出现？

prompt.en: For priority 1, “Hurting Officer pattern path is the second organizing path”: Can you identify a situation where the expected pattern did not show up even though one supporting factor was present?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「伤官格路径是第二条组织路径」：有没有一种情况：虽然某个成格支持已经出现，但整段格局表现并没有随之成立？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “expression and output comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「表达与输出在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “expression and output comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「表达与输出在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Take the same kind of task under two different conditions: when support is available and when pressure is high. What changes in stamina, pace or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：拿同一类任务比较两个条件：支持充足时与压力偏高时，你的持续力、节奏或恢复方式有什么明显变化？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Which part of this carrying pattern feels stable across years, and which part appears mainly under specific environments or workloads?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：这组承载模式里，哪些部分多年都比较稳定，哪些只在特定环境、工作量或责任阶段出现？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “The selected timing window is re-emphasizing natal themes”: Around the selected timing window, which natal theme became noticeably more foregrounded compared with the period before it?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「所选时间窗口正在重新放大原局已有主题」：在所选时间窗口前后比较，哪一个原局主题确实比之前更明显地进入前景？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “The selected timing window is re-emphasizing natal themes”: What did not change despite the timing activation, and what does that tell you about the difference between natal baseline and temporary emphasis?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「所选时间窗口正在重新放大原局已有主题」：即使时间层有所激活，哪些部分其实没有改变？这能怎样帮助你区分原局基线与阶段性前景？

prompt.en: For priority 5, “peer and self-position comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 5 条主线「同类与自我位置在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 5, “peer and self-position comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 5 条主线「同类与自我位置在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: Across your last two or three work settings, which mix of responsibility, output, resources and learning kept repeating?
prompt.zhHans: 回看最近两三个工作环境，责任、输出、资源交换与学习支持中，哪一种组合最常重复？

prompt.en: What kind of role looks suitable on paper but becomes unsustainable once the real carrying cost appears?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些角色表面上看起来适合，但真正进入持续执行后，会因为承载成本而变得难以长期维持？

prompt.en: When resources accumulate more smoothly, is the key difference production, management, exchange, restraint—or the timing of those actions?
prompt.zhHans: 当资源累积比较顺时，真正的差别更常来自产出、管理、交换、节制，还是行动时机？

prompt.en: Where has the chart-like resource pattern failed to predict reality because market, family obligation or personal choice dominated instead?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些财富经验并不符合这段结构，因为市场、家庭责任或个人选择反而占了主导？

prompt.en: Which relationship pattern repeats across different people even when the personalities involved are very different?
prompt.zhHans: 即使对象性格完全不同，哪些互动模式仍会在不同关系里重复？

prompt.en: What boundary, expectation or resource condition changes the relationship dynamic most dramatically?

prompt.en: Which family or background pattern is truly persistent across life stages, and which one belonged mainly to a specific period?

prompt.en: Where does chosen support outside the family reproduce—or correct—the same pattern seen in the original environment?

prompt.en: Which ability becomes reliable only after repeated practice and support, and which one appears easily but is harder to sustain?

prompt.en: What context consistently blocks expression even when the underlying skill is present?

prompt.en: What kind of pressure improves focus, and what kind consistently reduces judgment, pacing or recovery?

prompt.en: When the same responsibility becomes easier to carry, what changed first: support, clarity, authority, time or resources?

prompt.en: Over a normal month, where does the cycle of support → output → resource exchange → responsibility flow smoothly, and where does it repeatedly break?

prompt.en: What small environmental change produces the largest improvement in your day-to-day operating rhythm?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一个很小的环境调整，最容易带来日常运行节奏上最大的改善？

prompt.en: Compare the period before, during and after this target window: which already-present natal theme actually changes in visibility?
prompt.zhHans: 把目标时间窗口的前、当下与之后放在一起比较：原局已经存在的主题里，哪一个真正改变了可见度？

prompt.en: If the expected timing emphasis is absent, what competing responsibility, environment or choice better explains the real outcome?
prompt.zhHans: 如果预期的时间强调并没有出现，现实里是否有更强的责任、环境或选择更能解释结果？

headline.en: 壬 Day Master · 子 month command: read the whole-chart thread before individual symbols
headline.zhHans: 壬日主 · 子月令：先读整盘主线，再读单项符号

paragraphs.en: The most useful starting point is not a Ten-God catalogue, but how Jian Lu / Yue Jie path, learning, support and absorption, and environment ↔ later expression organize the chart together. They set the reading order for pattern, relationships, life domains and timing.
paragraphs.zhHans: 这张盘最值得先看的不是十神清单，而是建禄／月劫路径、学习、支持与吸收、月令环境 ↔ 后续表达怎样同时组织整盘。它们会决定后面的格局、关系、人生主题与时间层应该用什么顺序阅读。

paragraphs.en: The raw Five-Element composition is led by earth at about 33.3%, but that is only background composition. The main thread still depends on month command, Day-Master carrying, functional groups and pillar interfaces working together.
paragraphs.zhHans: 原始五行里土约占 33.3%，但这只是组成背景。真正的主线仍要回到月令、日主承载、十神功能组与干支接口之间的组合。

title.en: Jian Lu / Yue Jie path is the second organizing path
title.zhHans: 建禄／月劫路径是第二条组织路径

thesis.en: 劫财 enters the month-command pattern discussion with 1 visible formation path and 1 relationship modifier to review.
thesis.zhHans: 劫财从月令路径进入格局讨论，目前可见 1 条成格支持，同时有 1 项干支关系需要一起修正。

development.en: The useful question is not whether the chart can be given a pattern label, but whether formation support, Day-Master carrying, Ten-God composition and relationship modifiers can hold together.
development.zhHans: 因此这里真正要读的不是“有没有一个格局名称”，而是这些支持条件能否和日主承载、十神组合及关系修正同时成立。

condition.en: The path can be explained in depth without being promoted automatically to one final primary pattern.
condition.zhHans: 当前格局路径可以深入解释，但不会因为某一条件突出就自动升级成唯一主格。

title.en: learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 38.5% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Indirect Resource and Direct Resource, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 38.5%，主要由偏印、正印构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: learning, support and absorption deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「学习、支持与吸收」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how learning, support and absorption changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「学习、支持与吸收」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

title.en: environment ↔ later expression is the first interface to read
title.zhHans: 月令环境 ↔ 后续表达是整盘最先要看的接口

thesis.en: 子 and 丑 form a six-combination link at an interface that directly touches both the Day Master and month command, so it can reshape how other themes work together.
thesis.zhHans: 子、丑之间形成地支六合，而且同时直接碰到日主与月令，所以它不是边缘信息，而是会改写其他主题怎样彼此配合的主线。

development.en: This interface pulls rules, responsibility and pressure, learning, support and absorption, and peer and self-position into one reading. Rules, resources, support and expression should therefore be read together rather than as isolated symbols.
development.zhHans: 这条接口把规则、责任与压力、学习、支持与吸收、同类与自我位置拉进同一处阅读。也就是说，规则、资源、支持或表达不宜各自孤立解释，要看它们在环境与自我之间怎样同时发生。

condition.en: a six-combination link describes structural interaction, not a guaranteed event. Its lived form still depends on context, role and later timing layers.
condition.zhHans: 地支六合描述的是结构关系，不等于现实里一定发生某类事件；真正表现仍取决于场景、角色与后续时间层。

title.en: Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading
title.zhHans: 日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题

thesis.en: The current carrying structure shows output and consumption are more visible: roots 3, visible support 1, drain/consumption 6, and pressure 0.
thesis.zhHans: 当前承载结构呈「外泄与耗力侧更明显」：根气 3、可见生扶 1、泄耗 6、克 0。

development.en: This changes how much support, output cost and external demand the other themes can actually carry, which is more informative than applying a one-word strong/weak sticker.
development.zhHans: 这组结构决定其他主题落到现实运行时有多少支撑、多少输出成本、又要面对多少外部要求，因此它比单独贴“身强／身弱”更有解释力。

condition.en: This describes carrying conditions. It does not create a weighted strength score or turn a temporary pressure state into a fixed identity.
condition.zhHans: 这里读的是承载条件，不制造加权旺衰分数，也不把一个阶段性的压力状态当成固定身份。

title.en: The selected timing window is re-emphasizing natal themes
title.zhHans: 所选时间窗口正在重新放大原局已有主题

thesis.en: This timing window contains 0 cross-layer groups and 3 timing interactions, making timing relevant to the main reading thread.
thesis.zhHans: 这个时间窗口可见 0 组跨层结构与 3 项时间互动，因此时间层值得进入主线阅读。

development.en: Timing does not create a new natal chart; it changes which already-present natal themes move closer to the foreground through Da Yun and Liu Nian.
development.zhHans: 时间层不会产生一张新的命盘；它只是让原局某些已经存在的主题在大运与流年里更靠前。

condition.en: Foregrounding means the theme deserves attention in this period, not that a specific event must happen.
condition.zhHans: 前景化表示这个阶段更值得观察，不等于某个事件必然发生。

lead.en: Work is read here as the way output, responsibility, resources and learning are organized into a usable role.
lead.zhHans: 事业主题看的是表达产出、规则责任、资源交换与学习支持怎样组织成可持续的工作方式。

development.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 30.8%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Direct Resource, and Indirect Resource. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by interfaces such as environment ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 30.8%），主要连接到七杀、正印、偏印。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径，并经过月令环境 ↔ 后续表达等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Career structure can change with role, organization and timing. This describes work dynamics rather than fixing one profession into a guaranteed success-or-failure outcome.
condition.zhHans: 事业结构会随角色、组织环境与阶段而改变；这里说明的是工作运行方式，不把它直接写成某个职业的固定成败结论。

lead.en: Wealth is read as the chart’s resource flow: what can be produced, managed, exchanged and protected.
lead.zhHans: 财富主题看的是资源怎样被产出、管理、交换与保留，而不是把一个财星直接等同于财富结果。

development.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is resources and exchange at about 7.7%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Rob Wealth, and Peer. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone.
development.zhHans: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「资源与交换」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 7.7%），主要连接到七杀、劫财、比肩。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径。

condition.en: Resource structure describes how money, opportunity and exchange enter the chart; it is not an income promise. Real outcomes still depend on choices, markets, responsibilities and timing.
condition.zhHans: 资源结构说明钱、机会与交换怎样进入命盘，不等同实际收入承诺；现实结果仍取决于选择、市场、责任与时间条件。

lead.en: Relationships are read through recurring interfaces between self-position, rules, resources and support, not through a single spouse label.
lead.zhHans: 关系主题看自我位置、规则、资源与支持怎样在不同关系接口里反复出现，而不是把某一柱直接等同某个人。

development.en: For relationships, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 30.8%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Direct Resource, and Rob Wealth. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by interfaces such as environment ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 1 whole-chart priority theme, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「关系」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 30.8%），主要连接到七杀、正印、劫财。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径，并经过月令环境 ↔ 后续表达等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 1 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Relationship structure is best used to observe interaction style, boundaries and recurring interfaces rather than to predict marriage, separation or one fixed partner outcome.
condition.zhHans: 关系结构更适合观察互动方式、边界与反复接口，不把它直接翻译成结婚、分手或某一种伴侣结果。

lead.en: Family and background are read as the chart’s support, belonging and environmental interfaces rather than fixed family-member assignments.
lead.zhHans: 家庭与背景主题看支持、归属与环境接口怎样组合，不把某一柱固定对应成某位家人。

development.en: For family and background, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 38.5%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Direct Resource, and Rob Wealth. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by interfaces such as environment ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 1 whole-chart priority theme, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「家庭与背景」而言，在这个主题里，「学习、支持与吸收」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 38.5%），主要连接到七杀、正印、劫财。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径，并经过月令环境 ↔ 后续表达等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 1 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Family roles and real people change across life stages, so this reading stays with support and environmental structure instead of assigning one pillar to one family member.
condition.zhHans: 家庭角色与现实成员会随人生阶段变化，因此这里只读支持与环境结构，不固定指定哪一柱就是哪一位家人。

lead.en: Capability is read from what can be absorbed, practiced, expressed and repeatedly carried.
lead.zhHans: 能力主题看一项东西能否被吸收、练习、表达并反复承载。

development.en: For capability and expression, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 38.5%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Direct Resource, and Rob Wealth. It also connects to Jian Lu / Yue Jie path and is modified by interfaces such as environment ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「能力与表达」而言，在这个主题里，「学习、支持与吸收」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 38.5%），主要连接到七杀、正印、劫财。同时可连接到建禄／月劫路径，并经过月令环境 ↔ 后续表达等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Reliability still depends on whether roots 3, support 1 and output cost 6 can work together over time.
condition.zhHans: 能力是否稳定，要继续看根气 3、生扶 1 与输出成本 6 能不能长期配合。

lead.en: Pressure is read from standards and control together with the support available to carry them.
lead.zhHans: 压力主题把规则与受克放在可用支持和承载条件里一起读。

development.en: For pressure and responsibility, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 30.8%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Direct Resource, and Rob Wealth. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by interfaces such as environment ↔ later expression. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.

condition.en: The carrying side currently shows output and consumption are more visible, so pressure should be read against visible support 1 and pressure 0, not Officer count alone.
condition.zhHans: 承载侧目前呈「外泄与耗力侧更明显」，所以压力要同时看可用支持 1 与受克 0，不能只看官杀数量。

lead.en: Life operation asks whether support, output, resources, responsibility and relationships can circulate as one system.
lead.zhHans: 生活运行看支持、输出、资源、责任与关系能不能形成一套可持续循环。

development.en: For life operation, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 38.5%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Direct Resource, and Rob Wealth. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「生活运行」而言，在这个主题里，「学习、支持与吸收」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 38.5%），主要连接到七杀、正印、劫财。同时可连接到建禄／月劫路径，并经过月令环境 ↔ 后续表达等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: The key is not which function wins permanently, but whether support, output, resources and responsibility can return to a sustainable circulation across changing periods.
condition.zhHans: 生活运行的关键不是哪一组永远占上风，而是支持、输出、资源与责任能否在不同阶段重新找到可持续的循环。

headline.en: 2026-10-09: 壬辰 Da Yun × 丙午 Liu Nian

paragraphs.en: This window does not create a new chart; it carries the natal thread into time. The current Da Yun brings in peer and self-position, rules, responsibility and pressure, and expression and output, while Liu Nian adds resources and exchange and rules, responsibility and pressure, reconnecting to Jian Lu / Yue Jie path, environment ↔ later expression, and Day-Master carrying.
paragraphs.zhHans: 这个窗口不是另起一张命盘，而是把原局主线带进时间层。当前大运带入同类与自我位置、规则、责任与压力、表达与输出，流年再加入资源与交换、规则、责任与压力；它们重新连接到建禄／月劫路径、月令环境 ↔ 后续表达、日主承载。

paragraphs.en: capability and expression, career and work, and family and background move closer to the foreground in this window. When Da Yun and Liu Nian point to the same domain, the convergence increases structural relevance rather than proving an event.
paragraphs.zhHans: 能力与表达、事业与工作、家庭与背景在这个窗口更靠前。 如果大运与流年同时指向同一主题，只表示结构相关性增加，不把这种汇合写成事件确定性。

prompt.en: For priority 1, “Jian Lu / Yue Jie path is the second organizing path”: When this pattern path works best in real life, which supporting conditions tend to appear together rather than separately?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「建禄／月劫路径是第二条组织路径」：这条格局路径在现实里运行得比较顺时，哪些支持条件通常会一起出现，而不是各自单独出现？

prompt.en: For priority 1, “Jian Lu / Yue Jie path is the second organizing path”: Can you identify a situation where the expected pattern did not show up even though one supporting factor was present?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「建禄／月劫路径是第二条组织路径」：有没有一种情况：虽然某个成格支持已经出现，但整段格局表现并没有随之成立？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “environment ↔ later expression is the first interface to read”: Across different roles or environments, where does this same interface repeat—and where does it behave differently?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「月令环境 ↔ 后续表达是整盘最先要看的接口」：把同一个接口放到不同角色或环境里看：哪些互动模式会重复，哪些情境下反而表现不同？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “environment ↔ later expression is the first interface to read”: What lived example most clearly contradicts this relationship reading, and what condition was different in that case?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「月令环境 ↔ 后续表达是整盘最先要看的接口」：哪一个真实例子最不符合这段关系解读？当时的环境、角色或资源条件有什么不同？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Take the same kind of task under two different conditions: when support is available and when pressure is high. What changes in stamina, pace or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：拿同一类任务比较两个条件：支持充足时与压力偏高时，你的持续力、节奏或恢复方式有什么明显变化？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Which part of this carrying pattern feels stable across years, and which part appears mainly under specific environments or workloads?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：这组承载模式里，哪些部分多年都比较稳定，哪些只在特定环境、工作量或责任阶段出现？

prompt.en: For priority 5, “The selected timing window is re-emphasizing natal themes”: Around the selected timing window, which natal theme became noticeably more foregrounded compared with the period before it?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 5 条主线「所选时间窗口正在重新放大原局已有主题」：在所选时间窗口前后比较，哪一个原局主题确实比之前更明显地进入前景？

prompt.en: For priority 5, “The selected timing window is re-emphasizing natal themes”: What did not change despite the timing activation, and what does that tell you about the difference between natal baseline and temporary emphasis?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 5 条主线「所选时间窗口正在重新放大原局已有主题」：即使时间层有所激活，哪些部分其实没有改变？这能怎样帮助你区分原局基线与阶段性前景？

prompt.en: Across your last two or three work settings, which mix of responsibility, output, resources and learning kept repeating?
prompt.zhHans: 回看最近两三个工作环境，责任、输出、资源交换与学习支持中，哪一种组合最常重复？

prompt.en: What kind of role looks suitable on paper but becomes unsustainable once the real carrying cost appears?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些角色表面上看起来适合，但真正进入持续执行后，会因为承载成本而变得难以长期维持？

prompt.en: When resources accumulate more smoothly, is the key difference production, management, exchange, restraint—or the timing of those actions?
prompt.zhHans: 当资源累积比较顺时，真正的差别更常来自产出、管理、交换、节制，还是行动时机？

prompt.en: Where has the chart-like resource pattern failed to predict reality because market, family obligation or personal choice dominated instead?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些财富经验并不符合这段结构，因为市场、家庭责任或个人选择反而占了主导？

prompt.en: Which relationship pattern repeats across different people even when the personalities involved are very different?
prompt.zhHans: 即使对象性格完全不同，哪些互动模式仍会在不同关系里重复？

prompt.en: What boundary, expectation or resource condition changes the relationship dynamic most dramatically?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一种边界、期待或资源条件一改变，关系互动就会明显变成另一种样子？

prompt.en: Which family or background pattern is truly persistent across life stages, and which one belonged mainly to a specific period?
prompt.zhHans: 哪些家庭／背景模式跨阶段都持续存在，哪些其实只属于某一个人生时期？

prompt.en: Where does chosen support outside the family reproduce—or correct—the same pattern seen in the original environment?
prompt.zhHans: 家庭以外后来选择的支持系统，在哪些地方重现了原有模式，又在哪些地方修正了它？

prompt.en: Which ability becomes reliable only after repeated practice and support, and which one appears easily but is harder to sustain?
prompt.zhHans: 哪些能力要经过反复练习与支持才会稳定，哪些能力很容易出现，却比较难持续？

prompt.en: What context consistently blocks expression even when the underlying skill is present?
prompt.zhHans: 明明能力已经存在时，哪些情境仍会稳定地阻碍表达或发挥？

prompt.en: What kind of pressure improves focus, and what kind consistently reduces judgment, pacing or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一种压力会提升专注，哪一种压力反而会持续削弱判断、节奏或恢复？

prompt.en: When the same responsibility becomes easier to carry, what changed first: support, clarity, authority, time or resources?
prompt.zhHans: 同一种责任变得更容易承接时，最先改变的通常是支持、清晰度、权限、时间还是资源？

prompt.en: Over a normal month, where does the cycle of support → output → resource exchange → responsibility flow smoothly, and where does it repeatedly break?
prompt.zhHans: 以一个普通月份来看，支持 → 输出 → 资源交换 → 责任这条循环在哪里最顺，在哪里最容易反复断掉？

prompt.en: What small environmental change produces the largest improvement in your day-to-day operating rhythm?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一个很小的环境调整，最容易带来日常运行节奏上最大的改善？

prompt.en: Compare the period before, during and after this target window: which already-present natal theme actually changes in visibility?
prompt.zhHans: 把目标时间窗口的前、当下与之后放在一起比较：原局已经存在的主题里，哪一个真正改变了可见度？

prompt.en: If the expected timing emphasis is absent, what competing responsibility, environment or choice better explains the real outcome?
prompt.zhHans: 如果预期的时间强调并没有出现，现实里是否有更强的责任、环境或选择更能解释结果？

headline.en: 己 Day Master · 申 month command: read the whole-chart thread before individual symbols
headline.zhHans: 己日主 · 申月令：先读整盘主线，再读单项符号

paragraphs.en: The most useful starting point is not a Ten-God catalogue, but how Jian Lu / Yue Jie path, peer and self-position, and outer context ↔ environment organize the chart together. They set the reading order for pattern, relationships, life domains and timing.
paragraphs.zhHans: 这张盘最值得先看的不是十神清单，而是建禄／月劫路径、同类与自我位置、外部背景 ↔ 月令环境怎样同时组织整盘。它们会决定后面的格局、关系、人生主题与时间层应该用什么顺序阅读。

paragraphs.en: The raw Five-Element composition is led by earth at about 45%, but that is only background composition. The main thread still depends on month command, Day-Master carrying, functional groups and pillar interfaces working together.
paragraphs.zhHans: 原始五行里土约占 45%，但这只是组成背景。真正的主线仍要回到月令、日主承载、十神功能组与干支接口之间的组合。

title.en: Jian Lu / Yue Jie path is the second organizing path
title.zhHans: 建禄／月劫路径是第二条组织路径

thesis.en: 劫财 enters the month-command pattern discussion with 1 visible formation path and 1 relationship modifier to review.
thesis.zhHans: 劫财从月令路径进入格局讨论，目前可见 1 条成格支持，同时有 1 项干支关系需要一起修正。

development.en: The useful question is not whether the chart can be given a pattern label, but whether formation support, Day-Master carrying, Ten-God composition and relationship modifiers can hold together.
development.zhHans: 因此这里真正要读的不是“有没有一个格局名称”，而是这些支持条件能否和日主承载、十神组合及关系修正同时成立。

condition.en: The path can be explained in depth without being promoted automatically to one final primary pattern.
condition.zhHans: 当前格局路径可以深入解释，但不会因为某一条件突出就自动升级成唯一主格。

title.en: peer and self-position comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 同类与自我位置在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 33.3% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Peer and Rob Wealth, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 33.3%，主要由比肩、劫财构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: peer and self-position deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「同类与自我位置」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how peer and self-position changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「同类与自我位置」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

title.en: outer context ↔ environment is the first interface to read
title.zhHans: 外部背景 ↔ 月令环境是整盘最先要看的接口

thesis.en: 辛 and 丙 form a stem combination at an interface that directly touches both the Day Master and month command, so it can reshape how other themes work together.
thesis.zhHans: 辛、丙之间形成天干相合，而且同时直接碰到日主与月令，所以它不是边缘信息，而是会改写其他主题怎样彼此配合的主线。

development.en: This interface pulls expression and output, learning, support and absorption, peer and self-position, and rules, responsibility and pressure into one reading. Rules, resources, support and expression should therefore be read together rather than as isolated symbols.
development.zhHans: 这条接口把表达与输出、学习、支持与吸收、同类与自我位置、规则、责任与压力拉进同一处阅读。也就是说，规则、资源、支持或表达不宜各自孤立解释，要看它们在环境与自我之间怎样同时发生。

condition.en: a stem combination describes structural interaction, not a guaranteed event. Its lived form still depends on context, role and later timing layers.
condition.zhHans: 天干相合描述的是结构关系，不等于现实里一定发生某类事件；真正表现仍取决于场景、角色与后续时间层。

title.en: Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading
title.zhHans: 日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题

thesis.en: The current carrying structure shows support and carrying are more visible: roots 4, visible support 6, drain/consumption 1, and pressure 0.
thesis.zhHans: 当前承载结构呈「承载与支持侧更明显」：根气 4、可见生扶 6、泄耗 1、克 0。

development.en: This changes how much support, output cost and external demand the other themes can actually carry, which is more informative than applying a one-word strong/weak sticker.
development.zhHans: 这组结构决定其他主题落到现实运行时有多少支撑、多少输出成本、又要面对多少外部要求，因此它比单独贴“身强／身弱”更有解释力。

condition.en: This describes carrying conditions. It does not create a weighted strength score or turn a temporary pressure state into a fixed identity.
condition.zhHans: 这里读的是承载条件，不制造加权旺衰分数，也不把一个阶段性的压力状态当成固定身份。

title.en: rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 20% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Seven Killings, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 20%，主要由七杀构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: rules, responsibility and pressure deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「规则、责任与压力」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how rules, responsibility and pressure changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「规则、责任与压力」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

lead.en: Work is read here as the way output, responsibility, resources and learning are organized into a usable role.
lead.zhHans: 事业主题看的是表达产出、规则责任、资源交换与学习支持怎样组织成可持续的工作方式。

development.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 20%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Indirect Resource, and Indirect Wealth. It also connects to Wealth pattern path and Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 20%），主要连接到七杀、偏印、偏财。同时可连接到财格路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Career structure can change with role, organization and timing. This describes work dynamics rather than fixing one profession into a guaranteed success-or-failure outcome.
condition.zhHans: 事业结构会随角色、组织环境与阶段而改变；这里说明的是工作运行方式，不把它直接写成某个职业的固定成败结论。

lead.en: Wealth is read as the chart’s resource flow: what can be produced, managed, exchanged and protected.
lead.zhHans: 财富主题看的是资源怎样被产出、管理、交换与保留，而不是把一个财星直接等同于财富结果。

development.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 13.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Wealth pattern path and Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 13.3%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到财格路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Resource structure describes how money, opportunity and exchange enter the chart; it is not an income promise. Real outcomes still depend on choices, markets, responsibilities and timing.
condition.zhHans: 资源结构说明钱、机会与交换怎样进入命盘，不等同实际收入承诺；现实结果仍取决于选择、市场、责任与时间条件。

lead.en: Relationships are read through recurring interfaces between self-position, rules, resources and support, not through a single spouse label.
lead.zhHans: 关系主题看自我位置、规则、资源与支持怎样在不同关系接口里反复出现，而不是把某一柱直接等同某个人。

development.en: For relationships, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 33.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「关系」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 33.3%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到财格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Relationship structure is best used to observe interaction style, boundaries and recurring interfaces rather than to predict marriage, separation or one fixed partner outcome.
condition.zhHans: 关系结构更适合观察互动方式、边界与反复接口，不把它直接翻译成结婚、分手或某一种伴侣结果。

lead.en: Family and background are read as the chart’s support, belonging and environmental interfaces rather than fixed family-member assignments.
lead.zhHans: 家庭与背景主题看支持、归属与环境接口怎样组合，不把某一柱固定对应成某位家人。

development.en: For family and background, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 33.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「家庭与背景」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 33.3%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到财格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Family roles and real people change across life stages, so this reading stays with support and environmental structure instead of assigning one pillar to one family member.
condition.zhHans: 家庭角色与现实成员会随人生阶段变化，因此这里只读支持与环境结构，不固定指定哪一柱就是哪一位家人。

lead.en: Capability is read from what can be absorbed, practiced, expressed and repeatedly carried.
lead.zhHans: 能力主题看一项东西能否被吸收、练习、表达并反复承载。

development.en: For capability and expression, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 33.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Jian Lu / Yue Jie path and Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「能力与表达」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 33.3%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到建禄／月劫路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Reliability still depends on whether roots 4, support 6 and output cost 1 can work together over time.
condition.zhHans: 能力是否稳定，要继续看根气 4、生扶 6 与输出成本 1 能不能长期配合。

lead.en: Pressure is read from standards and control together with the support available to carry them.
lead.zhHans: 压力主题把规则与受克放在可用支持和承载条件里一起读。

development.en: For pressure and responsibility, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 20%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「压力与责任」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 20%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: The carrying side currently shows support and carrying are more visible, so pressure should be read against visible support 6 and pressure 0, not Officer count alone.
condition.zhHans: 承载侧目前呈「承载与支持侧更明显」，所以压力要同时看可用支持 6 与受克 0，不能只看官杀数量。

lead.en: Life operation asks whether support, output, resources, responsibility and relationships can circulate as one system.
lead.zhHans: 生活运行看支持、输出、资源、责任与关系能不能形成一套可持续循环。

development.en: For life operation, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 33.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Jian Lu / Yue Jie path and Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「生活运行」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 33.3%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到建禄／月劫路径、财格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: The key is not which function wins permanently, but whether support, output, resources and responsibility can return to a sustainable circulation across changing periods.
condition.zhHans: 生活运行的关键不是哪一组永远占上风，而是支持、输出、资源与责任能否在不同阶段重新找到可持续的循环。

headline.en: Timing narrative becomes available after a complete target time is selected.
headline.zhHans: 选择完整目标时间后，才会生成当前时间窗口的连续解读。

prompt.en: For priority 1, “Jian Lu / Yue Jie path is the second organizing path”: When this pattern path works best in real life, which supporting conditions tend to appear together rather than separately?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「建禄／月劫路径是第二条组织路径」：这条格局路径在现实里运行得比较顺时，哪些支持条件通常会一起出现，而不是各自单独出现？

prompt.en: For priority 1, “Jian Lu / Yue Jie path is the second organizing path”: Can you identify a situation where the expected pattern did not show up even though one supporting factor was present?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「建禄／月劫路径是第二条组织路径」：有没有一种情况：虽然某个成格支持已经出现，但整段格局表现并没有随之成立？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “peer and self-position comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「同类与自我位置在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “peer and self-position comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「同类与自我位置在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “outer context ↔ environment is the first interface to read”: Across different roles or environments, where does this same interface repeat—and where does it behave differently?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「外部背景 ↔ 月令环境是整盘最先要看的接口」：把同一个接口放到不同角色或环境里看：哪些互动模式会重复，哪些情境下反而表现不同？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “outer context ↔ environment is the first interface to read”: What lived example most clearly contradicts this relationship reading, and what condition was different in that case?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「外部背景 ↔ 月令环境是整盘最先要看的接口」：哪一个真实例子最不符合这段关系解读？当时的环境、角色或资源条件有什么不同？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Take the same kind of task under two different conditions: when support is available and when pressure is high. What changes in stamina, pace or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：拿同一类任务比较两个条件：支持充足时与压力偏高时，你的持续力、节奏或恢复方式有什么明显变化？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Which part of this carrying pattern feels stable across years, and which part appears mainly under specific environments or workloads?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：这组承载模式里，哪些部分多年都比较稳定，哪些只在特定环境、工作量或责任阶段出现？

prompt.en: For priority 5, “rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 5 条主线「规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 5, “rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 5 条主线「规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: Across your last two or three work settings, which mix of responsibility, output, resources and learning kept repeating?
prompt.zhHans: 回看最近两三个工作环境，责任、输出、资源交换与学习支持中，哪一种组合最常重复？

prompt.en: What kind of role looks suitable on paper but becomes unsustainable once the real carrying cost appears?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些角色表面上看起来适合，但真正进入持续执行后，会因为承载成本而变得难以长期维持？

prompt.en: When resources accumulate more smoothly, is the key difference production, management, exchange, restraint—or the timing of those actions?
prompt.zhHans: 当资源累积比较顺时，真正的差别更常来自产出、管理、交换、节制，还是行动时机？

prompt.en: Where has the chart-like resource pattern failed to predict reality because market, family obligation or personal choice dominated instead?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些财富经验并不符合这段结构，因为市场、家庭责任或个人选择反而占了主导？

prompt.en: Which relationship pattern repeats across different people even when the personalities involved are very different?
prompt.zhHans: 即使对象性格完全不同，哪些互动模式仍会在不同关系里重复？

prompt.en: What boundary, expectation or resource condition changes the relationship dynamic most dramatically?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一种边界、期待或资源条件一改变，关系互动就会明显变成另一种样子？

prompt.en: Which family or background pattern is truly persistent across life stages, and which one belonged mainly to a specific period?
prompt.zhHans: 哪些家庭／背景模式跨阶段都持续存在，哪些其实只属于某一个人生时期？

prompt.en: Where does chosen support outside the family reproduce—or correct—the same pattern seen in the original environment?
prompt.zhHans: 家庭以外后来选择的支持系统，在哪些地方重现了原有模式，又在哪些地方修正了它？

prompt.en: Which ability becomes reliable only after repeated practice and support, and which one appears easily but is harder to sustain?
prompt.zhHans: 哪些能力要经过反复练习与支持才会稳定，哪些能力很容易出现，却比较难持续？

prompt.en: What context consistently blocks expression even when the underlying skill is present?
prompt.zhHans: 明明能力已经存在时，哪些情境仍会稳定地阻碍表达或发挥？

prompt.en: What kind of pressure improves focus, and what kind consistently reduces judgment, pacing or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一种压力会提升专注，哪一种压力反而会持续削弱判断、节奏或恢复？

prompt.en: When the same responsibility becomes easier to carry, what changed first: support, clarity, authority, time or resources?
prompt.zhHans: 同一种责任变得更容易承接时，最先改变的通常是支持、清晰度、权限、时间还是资源？

prompt.en: Over a normal month, where does the cycle of support → output → resource exchange → responsibility flow smoothly, and where does it repeatedly break?
prompt.zhHans: 以一个普通月份来看，支持 → 输出 → 资源交换 → 责任这条循环在哪里最顺，在哪里最容易反复断掉？

prompt.en: What small environmental change produces the largest improvement in your day-to-day operating rhythm?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一个很小的环境调整，最容易带来日常运行节奏上最大的改善？

headline.en: 甲 Day Master · 子 month command: read the whole-chart thread before individual symbols
headline.zhHans: 甲日主 · 子月令：先读整盘主线，再读单项符号

paragraphs.en: The most useful starting point is not a Ten-God catalogue, but how Resource pattern path, learning, support and absorption, and Day-Master carrying organize the chart together. They set the reading order for pattern, relationships, life domains and timing.
paragraphs.zhHans: 这张盘最值得先看的不是十神清单，而是印格路径、学习、支持与吸收、日主承载怎样同时组织整盘。它们会决定后面的格局、关系、人生主题与时间层应该用什么顺序阅读。

paragraphs.en: The raw Five-Element composition is led by water at about 33.3%, but that is only background composition. The main thread still depends on month command, Day-Master carrying, functional groups and pillar interfaces working together.
paragraphs.zhHans: 原始五行里水约占 33.3%，但这只是组成背景。真正的主线仍要回到月令、日主承载、十神功能组与干支接口之间的组合。

title.en: Resource pattern path is the second organizing path
title.zhHans: 印格路径是第二条组织路径

thesis.en: 正印 enters the month-command pattern discussion with 3 visible formation paths.
thesis.zhHans: 正印从月令路径进入格局讨论，目前可见 3 条成格支持。

development.en: The useful question is not whether the chart can be given a pattern label, but whether formation support, Day-Master carrying, Ten-God composition and relationship modifiers can hold together.
development.zhHans: 因此这里真正要读的不是“有没有一个格局名称”，而是这些支持条件能否和日主承载、十神组合及关系修正同时成立。

condition.en: The path can be explained in depth without being promoted automatically to one final primary pattern.
condition.zhHans: 当前格局路径可以深入解释，但不会因为某一条件突出就自动升级成唯一主格。

title.en: learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 38.5% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Indirect Resource and Direct Resource, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 38.5%，主要由偏印、正印构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: learning, support and absorption deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「学习、支持与吸收」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how learning, support and absorption changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「学习、支持与吸收」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

title.en: Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading
title.zhHans: 日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题

thesis.en: The current carrying structure shows output and consumption are more visible: roots 0, visible support 1, drain/consumption 5, and pressure 1.
thesis.zhHans: 当前承载结构呈「外泄与耗力侧更明显」：根气 0、可见生扶 1、泄耗 5、克 1。

development.en: This changes how much support, output cost and external demand the other themes can actually carry, which is more informative than applying a one-word strong/weak sticker.
development.zhHans: 这组结构决定其他主题落到现实运行时有多少支撑、多少输出成本、又要面对多少外部要求，因此它比单独贴“身强／身弱”更有解释力。

condition.en: This describes carrying conditions. It does not create a weighted strength score or turn a temporary pressure state into a fixed identity.
condition.zhHans: 这里读的是承载条件，不制造加权旺衰分数，也不把一个阶段性的压力状态当成固定身份。

title.en: rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 23.1% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Seven Killings and Direct Officer, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 23.1%，主要由七杀、正官构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: rules, responsibility and pressure deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「规则、责任与压力」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how rules, responsibility and pressure changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「规则、责任与压力」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

lead.en: Work is read here as the way output, responsibility, resources and learning are organized into a usable role.
lead.zhHans: 事业主题看的是表达产出、规则责任、资源交换与学习支持怎样组织成可持续的工作方式。

development.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 23.1%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Indirect Wealth, and Seven Killings. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 23.1%），主要连接到偏印、偏财、七杀。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Career structure can change with role, organization and timing. This describes work dynamics rather than fixing one profession into a guaranteed success-or-failure outcome.
condition.zhHans: 事业结构会随角色、组织环境与阶段而改变；这里说明的是工作运行方式，不把它直接写成某个职业的固定成败结论。

lead.en: Wealth is read as the chart’s resource flow: what can be produced, managed, exchanged and protected.
lead.zhHans: 财富主题看的是资源怎样被产出、管理、交换与保留，而不是把一个财星直接等同于财富结果。

development.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is resources and exchange at about 23.1%, carried mainly by Indirect Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone. It directly reconnects to 1 whole-chart priority theme, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「资源与交换」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 23.1%），主要连接到偏财、七杀、比肩。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径。它与整盘 1 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Resource structure describes how money, opportunity and exchange enter the chart; it is not an income promise. Real outcomes still depend on choices, markets, responsibilities and timing.
condition.zhHans: 资源结构说明钱、机会与交换怎样进入命盘，不等同实际收入承诺；现实结果仍取决于选择、市场、责任与时间条件。

lead.en: Relationships are read through recurring interfaces between self-position, rules, resources and support, not through a single spouse label.
lead.zhHans: 关系主题看自我位置、规则、资源与支持怎样在不同关系接口里反复出现，而不是把某一柱直接等同某个人。

development.en: For relationships, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 23.1%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Indirect Wealth, and Seven Killings. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「关系」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 23.1%），主要连接到偏印、偏财、七杀。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Relationship structure is best used to observe interaction style, boundaries and recurring interfaces rather than to predict marriage, separation or one fixed partner outcome.
condition.zhHans: 关系结构更适合观察互动方式、边界与反复接口，不把它直接翻译成结婚、分手或某一种伴侣结果。

lead.en: Family and background are read as the chart’s support, belonging and environmental interfaces rather than fixed family-member assignments.
lead.zhHans: 家庭与背景主题看支持、归属与环境接口怎样组合，不把某一柱固定对应成某位家人。

development.en: For family and background, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 38.5%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Indirect Wealth, and Seven Killings. It also connects to Resource pattern path. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「家庭与背景」而言，在这个主题里，「学习、支持与吸收」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 38.5%），主要连接到偏印、偏财、七杀。同时可连接到印格路径。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Family roles and real people change across life stages, so this reading stays with support and environmental structure instead of assigning one pillar to one family member.
condition.zhHans: 家庭角色与现实成员会随人生阶段变化，因此这里只读支持与环境结构，不固定指定哪一柱就是哪一位家人。

lead.en: Capability is read from what can be absorbed, practiced, expressed and repeatedly carried.
lead.zhHans: 能力主题看一项东西能否被吸收、练习、表达并反复承载。

development.en: For capability and expression, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 38.5%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Resource pattern path. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「能力与表达」而言，在这个主题里，「学习、支持与吸收」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 38.5%），主要连接到偏印、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到印格路径。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: Reliability still depends on whether roots 0, support 1 and output cost 5 can work together over time.
condition.zhHans: 能力是否稳定，要继续看根气 0、生扶 1 与输出成本 5 能不能长期配合。

lead.en: Pressure is read from standards and control together with the support available to carry them.
lead.zhHans: 压力主题把规则与受克放在可用支持和承载条件里一起读。

development.en: For pressure and responsibility, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 23.1%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Seven Killings, and Peer. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「压力与责任」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 23.1%），主要连接到偏印、七杀、比肩。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: The carrying side currently shows output and consumption are more visible, so pressure should be read against visible support 1 and pressure 1, not Officer count alone.
condition.zhHans: 承载侧目前呈「外泄与耗力侧更明显」，所以压力要同时看可用支持 1 与受克 1，不能只看官杀数量。

lead.en: Life operation asks whether support, output, resources, responsibility and relationships can circulate as one system.
lead.zhHans: 生活运行看支持、输出、资源、责任与关系能不能形成一套可持续循环。

development.en: For life operation, the leading functional group is learning, support and absorption at about 38.5%, carried mainly by Indirect Resource, Indirect Wealth, and Seven Killings. It also connects to Resource pattern path. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
development.zhHans: 就「生活运行」而言，在这个主题里，「学习、支持与吸收」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 38.5%），主要连接到偏印、偏财、七杀。同时可连接到印格路径。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

condition.en: The key is not which function wins permanently, but whether support, output, resources and responsibility can return to a sustainable circulation across changing periods.
condition.zhHans: 生活运行的关键不是哪一组永远占上风，而是支持、输出、资源与责任能否在不同阶段重新找到可持续的循环。

headline.en: Timing narrative becomes available after a complete target time is selected.
headline.zhHans: 选择完整目标时间后，才会生成当前时间窗口的连续解读。

prompt.en: For priority 1, “Resource pattern path is the second organizing path”: When this pattern path works best in real life, which supporting conditions tend to appear together rather than separately?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「印格路径是第二条组织路径」：这条格局路径在现实里运行得比较顺时，哪些支持条件通常会一起出现，而不是各自单独出现？

prompt.en: For priority 1, “Resource pattern path is the second organizing path”: Can you identify a situation where the expected pattern did not show up even though one supporting factor was present?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 1 条主线「印格路径是第二条组织路径」：有没有一种情况：虽然某个成格支持已经出现，但整段格局表现并没有随之成立？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 2, “learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 2 条主线「学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Take the same kind of task under two different conditions: when support is available and when pressure is high. What changes in stamina, pace or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：拿同一类任务比较两个条件：支持充足时与压力偏高时，你的持续力、节奏或恢复方式有什么明显变化？

prompt.en: For priority 3, “Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading”: Which part of this carrying pattern feels stable across years, and which part appears mainly under specific environments or workloads?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 3 条主线「日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题」：这组承载模式里，哪些部分多年都比较稳定，哪些只在特定环境、工作量或责任阶段出现？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground”: In which recurring situations does this functional group become the default way you respond or organize action?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景」：在哪些反复出现的情境里，这个功能组最容易成为你默认的应对或行动方式？

prompt.en: For priority 4, “rules, responsibility and pressure comes to the foreground”: When another functional group takes over instead, what changed in the task, relationship, resources or pressure?
prompt.zhHans: 针对第 4 条主线「规则、责任与压力在十神结构中进入前景」：当现实里反而由另一个功能组接管时，任务、关系、资源或压力条件发生了什么变化？

prompt.en: Across your last two or three work settings, which mix of responsibility, output, resources and learning kept repeating?
prompt.zhHans: 回看最近两三个工作环境，责任、输出、资源交换与学习支持中，哪一种组合最常重复？

prompt.en: What kind of role looks suitable on paper but becomes unsustainable once the real carrying cost appears?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些角色表面上看起来适合，但真正进入持续执行后，会因为承载成本而变得难以长期维持？

prompt.en: When resources accumulate more smoothly, is the key difference production, management, exchange, restraint—or the timing of those actions?
prompt.zhHans: 当资源累积比较顺时，真正的差别更常来自产出、管理、交换、节制，还是行动时机？

prompt.en: Where has the chart-like resource pattern failed to predict reality because market, family obligation or personal choice dominated instead?
prompt.zhHans: 有哪些财富经验并不符合这段结构，因为市场、家庭责任或个人选择反而占了主导？

prompt.en: Which relationship pattern repeats across different people even when the personalities involved are very different?
prompt.zhHans: 即使对象性格完全不同，哪些互动模式仍会在不同关系里重复？

prompt.en: What boundary, expectation or resource condition changes the relationship dynamic most dramatically?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一种边界、期待或资源条件一改变，关系互动就会明显变成另一种样子？

prompt.en: Which family or background pattern is truly persistent across life stages, and which one belonged mainly to a specific period?
prompt.zhHans: 哪些家庭／背景模式跨阶段都持续存在，哪些其实只属于某一个人生时期？

prompt.en: Where does chosen support outside the family reproduce—or correct—the same pattern seen in the original environment?
prompt.zhHans: 家庭以外后来选择的支持系统，在哪些地方重现了原有模式，又在哪些地方修正了它？

prompt.en: Which ability becomes reliable only after repeated practice and support, and which one appears easily but is harder to sustain?
prompt.zhHans: 哪些能力要经过反复练习与支持才会稳定，哪些能力很容易出现，却比较难持续？

prompt.en: What context consistently blocks expression even when the underlying skill is present?
prompt.zhHans: 明明能力已经存在时，哪些情境仍会稳定地阻碍表达或发挥？

prompt.en: What kind of pressure improves focus, and what kind consistently reduces judgment, pacing or recovery?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一种压力会提升专注，哪一种压力反而会持续削弱判断、节奏或恢复？

prompt.en: When the same responsibility becomes easier to carry, what changed first: support, clarity, authority, time or resources?
prompt.zhHans: 同一种责任变得更容易承接时，最先改变的通常是支持、清晰度、权限、时间还是资源？

prompt.en: Over a normal month, where does the cycle of support → output → resource exchange → responsibility flow smoothly, and where does it repeatedly break?
prompt.zhHans: 以一个普通月份来看，支持 → 输出 → 资源交换 → 责任这条循环在哪里最顺，在哪里最容易反复断掉？

prompt.en: What small environmental change produces the largest improvement in your day-to-day operating rhythm?
prompt.zhHans: 哪一个很小的环境调整，最容易带来日常运行节奏上最大的改善？

headline.en: 丁 Day Master · 卯 month command: read the whole-chart thread before individual symbols
headline.zhHans: 丁日主 · 卯月令：先读整盘主线，再读单项符号

paragraphs.en: The most useful starting point is not a Ten-God catalogue, but how Resource pattern path, learning, support and absorption, and self anchor ↔ later expression organize the chart together. They set the reading order for pattern, relationships, life domains and timing.
paragraphs.zhHans: 这张盘最值得先看的不是十神清单，而是印格路径、学习、支持与吸收、自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达怎样同时组织整盘。它们会决定后面的格局、关系、人生主题与时间层应该用什么顺序阅读。

paragraphs.en: The raw Five-Element composition is led by wood at about 46.7%, but that is only background composition. The main thread still depends on month command, Day-Master carrying, functional groups and pillar interfaces working together.
paragraphs.zhHans: 原始五行里木约占 46.7%，但这只是组成背景。真正的主线仍要回到月令、日主承载、十神功能组与干支接口之间的组合。

title.en: Resource pattern path is the second organizing path
title.zhHans: 印格路径是第二条组织路径

thesis.en: 偏印 enters the month-command pattern discussion with 1 visible formation path and 1 relationship modifier to review.
thesis.zhHans: 偏印从月令路径进入格局讨论，目前可见 1 条成格支持，同时有 1 项干支关系需要一起修正。

development.en: The useful question is not whether the chart can be given a pattern label, but whether formation support, Day-Master carrying, Ten-God composition and relationship modifiers can hold together.
development.zhHans: 因此这里真正要读的不是“有没有一个格局名称”，而是这些支持条件能否和日主承载、十神组合及关系修正同时成立。

condition.en: The path can be explained in depth without being promoted automatically to one final primary pattern.
condition.zhHans: 当前格局路径可以深入解释，但不会因为某一条件突出就自动升级成唯一主格。

title.en: learning, support and absorption comes to the foreground
title.zhHans: 学习、支持与吸收在十神结构中进入前景

thesis.en: This functional group accounts for about 40% of the current Ten-God occurrences and is carried mainly by Indirect Resource and Direct Resource, so it is likely to reappear across several life domains.
thesis.zhHans: 这一功能组约占当前十神落点的 40%，主要由偏印、正印构成，因此它会反复出现在多个生活主题里。

development.en: learning, support and absorption deserves early attention because it reconnects to multiple chart structures, not because a higher ratio is automatically better or a personality score.
development.zhHans: 「学习、支持与吸收」值得优先读，不是因为占比越高就越“好”或越像人格标签，而是因为它和整盘其他结构有更多重复连接。

condition.en: Later topic chapters show how learning, support and absorption changes by domain instead of repeating the same Ten-God definition seven times.
condition.zhHans: 后面的主题章节会继续说明「学习、支持与吸收」在不同领域怎样改变，而不是把同一句十神定义重复七次。

title.en: self anchor ↔ later expression is the first interface to read
title.zhHans: 自我锚点 ↔ 后续表达是整盘最先要看的接口

thesis.en: 卯 and 午 form a branch break relation at an interface that directly touches both the Day Master and month command, so it can reshape how other themes work together.
thesis.zhHans: 卯、午之间形成地支相破，而且同时直接碰到日主与月令，所以它不是边缘信息，而是会改写其他主题怎样彼此配合的主线。

development.en: This interface pulls peer and self-position, learning, support and absorption, and expression and output into one reading. Rules, resources, support and expression should therefore be read together rather than as isolated symbols.
development.zhHans: 这条接口把同类与自我位置、学习、支持与吸收、表达与输出拉进同一处阅读。也就是说，规则、资源、支持或表达不宜各自孤立解释，要看它们在环境与自我之间怎样同时发生。

condition.en: a branch break relation describes structural interaction, not a guaranteed event. Its lived form still depends on context, role and later timing layers.
condition.zhHans: 地支相破描述的是结构关系，不等于现实里一定发生某类事件；真正表现仍取决于场景、角色与后续时间层。

title.en: Whether the Day Master can carry the chart needs its own reading
title.zhHans: 日主能不能承接这些主题，是整盘必须单独看的问题

thesis.en: The current carrying structure shows support, output and pressure are mixed: roots 2, visible support 3, drain/consumption 4, and pressure 0.
thesis.zhHans: 当前承载结构呈「支持、外泄与压力并见」：根气 2、可见生扶 3、泄耗 4、克 0。

development.en: This changes how much support, output cost and external demand the other themes can actually carry, which is more informative than applying a one-word strong/weak sticker.
development.zhHans: 这组结构决定其他主题落到现实运行时有多少支撑、多少输出成本、又要面对多少外部要求，因此它比单独贴“身强／身弱”更有解释力。

condition.en: This describes carrying conditions. It does not create a weighted strength score or turn a temporary pressure state into a fixed identity.

development.en: Timing does not create a new natal chart; it changes which already-present natal themes move closer to the foreground through Da Yun and Liu Nian.
